body:
Parent V1-0477. Expose task-specific, bounded semantic methods and Corvint evidence joins through CLI/MCP without requiring an editor session. Avoid unrelated query fan-out and explain omissions.

Observed public failure to address: PR #360 two-witness baseline missed an expected definition relation at --limit 20 even though the same provider query digest/seeds showed that relation with --limit 32 (20 rows plus 12 omitted at the narrower projection; 64 queries in both). Task-relevant relation selection must happen before the final bounded CLI/MCP path-relation projection. Preserve the 20-row limit and report omissions rather than merely increasing it; prove the witness and a caller/reference counterexample without claiming broad recall from two public cases.
